_comment: Model constants. west_res is the reference fit; lambda, the leg thresholds and band_base are chosen by the cold-start replay (docs/cold-start-replay.md).

provenance.west_res: West Res model_defaults.json, fitted 2026-09-13 on 392 readings / 375 legs
provenance.replay: docs/cold-start-replay.md, 2026-10-18, West Res 416 readings 2024-11-05..2026-10-17. lambda 0.3 (tied with 0.1 within 0.01 C, larger chosen); scale from 2 legs (beats prior at every count); full from 30 legs (spec value kept, full never sustained a win on the reference water); band_base = replay p80/MAE spread x West Res production MAE on forecast weather (0.28 C 1d, 1.31 C 5d)
provenance.multipliers: spec values kept: the replay measures prior/scale at x0.95 of mature, but its prior is West Res's own fit, so it cannot measure a new water's prior error
